# UAI AI Research Center

**Universitas Al-Azhar Indonesia AI Research Center** · Program Studi Informatika
*Human-Centered, Responsible and Impact-Driven Artificial Intelligence Research.*

## Who We Are

Pusat riset AI Prodi Informatika UAI. Kami menjalankan GitHub bukan sebagai tempat menyimpan source code, melainkan sebagai **research operating system**: *institutional research memory + collaboration platform + reproducibility infrastructure* yang menghubungkan **Research Center → Dosen → Mata Kuliah → Mahasiswa → Problem → Dataset → Project → Metopen → TA → Paper → Publikasi / HKI / Produk → Research Center lagi.** Signature kami: **amanah epistemik** — mencari kebenaran, bukan membela hipotesis.

## Research Mission

Responsible, human-centered, impact-driven AI: riset yang menghasilkan *credible knowledge* dan artefak yang dapat direproduksi, bermanfaat bagi Indonesia, dan dipertanggungjawabkan secara ilmiah, etis, dan profesional. Prinsip kerja: **AI-augmented, human-accountable science** — AI adalah research copilot, bukan epistemic authority.

## Research Pipeline

**Discover → Build → Prove → Contribute → Scale**

Setiap riset melewati **8 Research Gates** dengan *definition of done*, bukti wajib, dan reviewer eksplisit:

| G1 | G2 | G3 | G4 | G5 | G6 | G7 | G8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Endgame Ready | Problem Ready | Evidence Ready | Question Ready | Method Ready | Experiment Ready | Claim Ready | Contribution Ready |

Issue adalah **unit riset** (Research Problem, Research Question, Dataset, Experiment, Literature Gap, Publication, Research Risk). Pull Request adalah **research review** (`GATE REVIEW: <gate>`; merge = gate lulus). Release adalah **milestone kematangan** (`v0.1` Problem Validated → `v1.0` Research Pack → `v2.0` Published). GitHub Projects adalah **Research Mission Control**.

Definisi gate: [OPS-03 Research Gates](../../research-os/06-execution-os/03-research-gates.md) · cara kerja: [Research OS](../../research-os/README.md) · tata kelola: [GOVERNANCE](../../GOVERNANCE.md).

## Current Research

Riset aktif dilacak di **Research Mission Control** (GitHub Projects) dan indeks problem bank: [Research Backlog](../../research-backlog/BACKLOG.md). Riset individual hidup di repositori `proj-YYYY-<topik>` dengan struktur standar [TPL-15](../../research-os/08-templates/15-research-repository-template.md) dan Research ID `UIAI-YYYY-NNN` sebagai primary key.

## Join Research

| Anda | Mulai dari |
|---|---|
| **Mahasiswa** | [Student Guide](../../research-based-learning/student-guide/README.md) → pilih/usulkan masalah lewat Issue **Research Problem** → buat repositori riset → ikuti [Metopen Research Studio](../../metopen-research-studio/README.md) minggu demi minggu |
| **Dosen** | [Faculty Guide](../../research-based-learning/faculty-guide/README.md) → tandai mata kuliah dengan mode F/E/R → daftarkan masalah/dataset → jadi mentor & reviewer gate |
| **Partner** (industri, pemerintah, masyarakat) | Ajukan masalah lewat Issue **Research Problem**; model kolaborasi *Domain Problem + Data + AI Capability + Evaluation + Impact* ([AIR-05](../../research-os/03-ai-research-ecosystem/05-research-demand-supply-marketplace.md)) |
